<?php

[$a, $b, $p, $x] = array_map(
    'intval',
    preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN)))
);

function modPow(int $base, int $exp, int $mod): int
{
    $result = 1;
    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $result = ($result * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp = intdiv($exp, 2);
    }
    return $result;
}

$m = $p - 1;
$period = $p * $m;
$fullPeriods = intdiv($x, $period);
$remainder = $x % $period;

$answer = $fullPeriods * $m;
$inverseA = modPow($a, $p - 2, $p);
$c = $b;

for ($r = 0; $r < $m; $r++) {
    $k = ($r - $c) % $p;
    if ($k < 0) {
        $k += $p;
    }

    $n = $r + $m * $k;
    if ($n > 0 && $n <= $remainder) {
        $answer++;
    }

    $c = ($c * $inverseA) % $p;
}

echo $answer, PHP_EOL;

    preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN)))

<?php

function modPow(int $base, int $exp, int $mod): int
{
    $result = 1;
    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $result = ($result * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp = intdiv($exp, 2);
    }
    return $result;
}

[$a, $b, $p, $x] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(file_get_contents('php://stdin'))));

$period = $p * ($p - 1);
$answer = intdiv($x, $period) * ($p - 1);
$remainder = $x % $period;

$inverseA = modPow($a, $p - 2, $p);
$inversePower = 1;

for ($k = 0; $k < $p - 1; $k++) {
    $r = ($b * $inversePower) % $p;
    $t = ($k - $r) % $p;
    if ($t < 0) {
        $t += $p;
    }

    $n = $k + ($p - 1) * $t;
    if ($n > 0 && $n <= $remainder) {
        $answer++;
    }

    $inversePower = ($inversePower * $inverseA) % $p;
}

echo $answer, PHP_EOL;

<?php

[$a, $b, $p, $x] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));

function modPow(int $base, int $exp, int $mod): int
{
    $result = 1;
    $base %= $mod;

    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $result = ($result * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp = intdiv($exp, 2);
    }

    return $result;
}

$order = $p - 1;
$value = $p - 1;
$factors = [];

for ($i = 2; $i * $i <= $value; $i++) {
    if ($value % $i === 0) {
        $factors[] = $i;
        while ($value % $i === 0) {
            $value = intdiv($value, $i);
        }
    }
}
if ($value > 1) {
    $factors[] = $value;
}

foreach ($factors as $factor) {
    while ($order % $factor === 0) {
        $candidate = intdiv($order, $factor);
        if (modPow($a, $candidate, $p) !== 1) {
            break;
        }
        $order = $candidate;
    }
}

$inverseOrder = modPow($order, $p - 2, $p);
$inverseA = modPow($a, $p - 2, $p);
$inversePower = 1;
$period = $order * $p;
$answer = 0;

for ($r = 0; $r < $order; $r++) {
    $requiredModP = ($b * $inversePower) % $p;
    $k = (($requiredModP - $r) * $inverseOrder) % $p;
    if ($k < 0) {
        $k += $p;
    }

    $first = $r + $order * $k;

    if ($first > 0 && $first <= $x) {
        $answer += intdiv($x - $first, $period) + 1;
    }

    $inversePower = ($inversePower * $inverseA) % $p;
}

echo $answer, PHP_EOL;
